key_insight: qReduMIS uses quantum QAOA measurements to prune a portfolio-selection graph, then hands the reduced problem to exact classical solvers for a practical hybrid speedup.
engineering_relevance: This shows a scalable quantum-classical workflow that can improve combinatorial optimization on real financial datasets without relying on quantum hardware to finish the full solve.
method: Model portfolio diversification as a Maximum Independent Set problem on asset-correlation graphs.
Run QAOA on graph kernels to sample candidate independent sets and identify frozen nodes.
Apply provably optimal classical reductions recursively until the remaining graph is small enough to solve exactly.
evidence_signal: Validated on four major market indices up to 225 assets and 73 benchmark graphs, with trapped-ion hardware runs up to 78 qubits and 1016 two-qubit gates; qReduMIS reached success probabilities of 0.40 and 0.95 on the two hardest indices and average approximation ratios of at least 0.96.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of QAOA samples and reduction heuristics, so hardware noise or poor kernel selection can weaken the end-to-end advantage.
paper_title: Quantum-Informed Portfolio Selection: An End-to-End Pipeline Validated on Trapped-Ion Hardware with Real Market Data
